headline: Houthi Missile Hits Riyadh Airport, 12 Dead; Saudi Strikes Sanaa
subheadline: Saudi warplanes retaliated against Sanaa International Airport after Houthi ballistic missile struck King Khalid Terminal 3, wounding over 300 people.
lede: A Houthi ballistic missile struck Riyadh's King Khalid Airport Terminal 3, killing at least 12 and wounding over 300 people of multiple nationalities, prompting immediate Saudi airstrikes on Sanaa International Airport. Simultaneously, Russia launched the war's largest drone wave — approximately 160 drones including 110 attack Shaheds — hitting Kyiv's western districts and the Lavina shopping mall while claiming five settlement captures across three Ukrainian oblasts. Israel convened an emergency security cabinet to assess multi-front threats as the IDF intercepted a suspicious aerial target over southern Lebanon and destroyed Hamas infrastructure in Gaza. Iran's IRGC Navy ordered six vessels away from UAE waters near the Strait of Hormuz, escalating maritime tensions.

sections.title: Russia Unleashes Record 160-Drone Barrage
sections.body: Russia launched approximately 160 drones overnight October 10-11, including 110 attack Shaheds that struck Kyiv's Nivky, Akadem, and Berkovets districts and the Lavina shopping mall. Geran-5 rockets proliferated across northern Ukraine, tracked from Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, and Bryansk toward Kyiv, Rivne, Volyn, Dnipropetrovsk, Cherkasy, and Khmelnytskyi regions. The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed capture of Annopol and Nova Kazachya in Kharkiv, Kiyanitsa in Sumy, and Samoylovka and Golubkovo in Zaporizhzhia during October 3-9. The United States threatened to suspend military aid over Ukrainian refinery strikes, with Trump demanding a halt to energy infrastructure attacks and floating a leadership change in Kyiv.

sections.title: Houthi Strike Triggers Saudi Retaliation, Multi-Front Alert
sections.body: A Houthi ballistic missile hit Riyadh's King Khalid Airport Terminal 3, causing at least 12 deaths and over 300 injuries across multiple nationalities. Saudi warplanes retaliated by striking Sanaa International Airport in Yemen. Israel's security cabinet convened an emergency session to assess threats across Lebanon, Syria, Gaza, and Iran fronts while the IDF intercepted a suspicious aerial target in southern Lebanon. IDF and Shin Bet forces destroyed a Hamas observation post, rocket launch site, and three weapons warehouses in Gaza as Iran's IRGC Navy ordered six vessels off UAE waters toward Dubai, with UKMTO confirming suspicious instructions.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Houthi missile strike on Riyadh marks a significant escalation in Red Sea conflict, drawing direct Saudi retaliation on Sanaa and suggesting coordinated axis activity with Iranian maritime pressure on the Strait of Hormuz. Russia's unprecedented 160-drone wave and claimed territorial gains signal sustained offensive momentum amid mounting U.S. diplomatic pressure over Ukrainian energy strikes. Israel's emergency cabinet session and simultaneous aerial incursions from Lebanon indicate a multi-front pressure campaign converging with Hamas operations in Gaza.
